result: In `uart_rx_core`, replace the variable bit-select assignment `rx_shift[bit_number - 14'd1] <= majority` with a right shift that inserts `majority` at the most significant bit on each data-bit decision. Keep the existing data-bit decision timing and start-bit initialization so that after eight LSB-first decisions, `rx_shift` contains the same byte for the stop-bit decision. Preserve all other counter, parameter, reset, and output behavior; do not add a numeric top latency annotation.
